record.name: Amazon Selling Partner
record.one_liner: The Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) provides programmatic access to inventory, orders, pricing, and other selling partner workflows.

auth.notes: Uses Login with Amazon (LWA) to exchange refresh tokens or client credentials for access tokens.

access.notes: Developer registration requests are evaluated by Amazon, and developers must complete profiles, policy requirements, and security controls.

api_surface.notes: Exposes REST endpoints, JSON schemas, notifications, and client SDKs.

mcp.notes: Reported value was discarded: no support offered.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials require approval, sales contact, or vendor provisioning, so an outside developer cannot start unaided. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)

evidence.claim: Authentication uses Login with Amazon (LWA) OAuth2 tokens.
evidence.quote: A Login with Amazon (LWA) access token authorizes your application to take certain actions on behalf of a selling partner.

evidence.claim: Developer access is subject to review and approval by Amazon.
evidence.quote: After you have submitted your request to register as a developer, Amazon evaluates the information provided and approves or denies your request.

evidence.claim: REST API and SDKs are supported.
evidence.quote: Tutorial: Automate your SP-API Calls Using a C# SDK
